tables.name: admin_users
tables.comment: Legacy platform allowlist, retained for menu-pictures storage policies. Own-row authenticated read only; trusted operator writes.

tables.name: menu_events
tables.comment: Append-only client telemetry: routed inserts; tenant member reads and deletes; no client updates.

tables.name: order_items
tables.comment: Immutable historical line-item snapshots for canonical tenant-owned orders.

tables.name: orders
tables.comment: Canonical tenant-owned restaurant orders. Customer submissions are accepted only through submit_order RPC; tenant members may read their tenant orders.

tables.name: payment_allocations
tables.comment: Server-recognized successful money allocated to an order. These rows, not browser success state, reduce the outstanding balance.

tables.name: payment_attempts
tables.comment: Tenant-owned payment attempts. Pending attempts reserve order balance for a bounded window; browser clients cannot write this table directly.

tables.name: restaurant_clients
tables.comment: Public platform routing registry: exact header-scoped SELECT; headerless legacy fallback exposes only the-bistro until cached pages are retired. Operator-managed writes only. A public slug is not authorization.

tables.name: service_tickets
tables.comment: Tenant-routed assistance queue: public pending inserts; tenant member read/status update; no client delete while Postgres Changes is published.

tables.name: table_access_contexts
tables.comment: Hashed bearer capabilities issued by an authorized tenant manager for a specific physical table. Tokens are never stored in plaintext.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ting_private.can_manage_tenant(target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_memberships m
    WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid() AND m.tenant_id = target
      AND m.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
  );
$function$

functions.name: expire_payment_reservations
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ting_private.expire_payment_reservations(p_tenant_id uuid, p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  affected integer;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.payment_attempts
  SET status = 'expired', updated_at = now(), cancelled_at = now()
  WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND order_id = p_order_id
    AND status IN ('created','pending')
    AND reservation_expires_at <= now();
  GET DIAGNOSTICS affected = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN affected;
END;
$function$

functions.name: prevent_menu_item_reassignment
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ting_private.prevent_menu_item_reassignment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id
     OR NEW.client_slug IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.client_slug THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Menu item tenant ownership is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ting_private.prevent_tenant_reassignment()
 RETURNS trigger

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tenant ownership is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: table_access_context_is_valid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ting_private.table_access_context_is_valid(p_tenant_id uuid, p_table_number text, p_token text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_tenant_id IS NULL
      OR p_table_number IS NULL
      OR p_token IS NULL
      OR p_token !~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$'
      THEN false
    ELSE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.table_access_contexts context
      WHERE context.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        AND context.table_number = trim(p_table_number)
        AND context.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND context.token_hash = extensions.digest(lower(p_token), 'sha256')
    )
  END;
$function$
functions.identity_args: p_tenant_id uuid, p_table_number text, p_token text
